name: Retro Colt AR-15 Carry Handle Scope
license_name: University of Illinois/NCSA Open Source License
description_html:
I am finally back, and stronger than ever!

I actually learned how to mod for real!

(Still can’t code though)

Make sure to load it last, or it won’t work on modded items

Immeasurable levels of thanks go to Tron, GrooveypenguinX, Syanide, EpicRangeTime, PETTAN and countless others on the WTT discord, without whose tools, help and support my contiuned modding journey wouldn’t have been possible

(and of course thanks to PIZZASPULUNKER, who suggested I make it)

Anyway, this is the scope that is meant to go on AR-15 carry handles and also ACOG mounts and that has a reticle similar to the PILAD scope in-game

Can be purchased from Peacekeeper LL1 for $129 or roughly ₽20k on flea, I hope you like it, and tell me about issues.

The UI Icon is a bit small, but I’m not sure what caused it or how to fix that.

I also gave it a stupidly long description

I’d say it looks pretty cool in its desired place

The reticle is tolerable of course

It can of course be placed on the ACOG mounts and I’d say it works quite well

I don’t know where the model came from but the textures were made by me using substance painter

That’s all from me, I have involved myself with development of the WTT (Welcome To Tarkov) modding project and things related to that is what you can expect to see from me in the future. If you want to find our more about WTT, then go onto any one of the standalone mods for it (I’m sure you’ve seen them around) and you can read up on everything there, have a great day.
